evidence.api_compatibility: No breaking changes. The change is internal to model discovery logic in `collect_registered_shards` and `try_resolve_registered_extra_cache`. Users upgrading will simply stop seeing spurious duplicate entries for incomplete shard families — a strictly additive correctness fix.

evidence.manual_release_testing: The change modifies model catalog discovery behavior — a registered multi-shard model with a missing or corrupt shard should no longer spawn an extra.* duplicate entry. However, the fix only suppresses behavior that was already buggy (spurious duplicates), and the existing test coverage is thorough. No manual release testing is required.
evidence.post_approval_commits: No commits were added after approval. The PR contains a single commit (14f04c6d) authored by @fl0rianr, approved at 2026-10-12T19:47:57Z, and merged at 2026-10-13T00:16:08Z. The merge went through the standard merge_group queue.
evidence.review: PR #3811 has one substantive approval from @superm1 (submitted 2026-10-12T19:47:57Z). @superm1's subject areas include llamacpp, which is directly relevant since the fix touches `src/cpp/server/model_manager.cpp` in the shard discovery path used by the llamacpp backend. The PR description is a follow-up to #3805 addressing a CodeRabbit finding — a narrow, well-contained bug fix. evidence.security: No security concerns. The change tightens catalog visibility for registered GGUF checkpoint paths by ensuring incomplete families are excluded from extra model discovery. evidence.tests: The PR adds comprehensive regression tests in `test/server_endpoints.py` for the `test_021ym_registered_shards_and_unrelated_quantization` test case. Three scenarios are covered: (1) only the first shard of a 2-shard family is present — the registered model is not downloaded and unrelated quantizations remain discoverable; (2) either the first or second shard is corrupted (zeroed size) — the whole registered family is suppressed and unrelated variants remain discoverable. No existing tests were weakened or deleted.

subject: fix(models): prevent duplicate discovery of incomplete shards (#3811)
summary: Prevents incomplete or corrupt registered GGUF shard families from appearing as extra.* duplicate models by recording ownership before validation and returning failure when any shard is incomplete or invalid, while preserving discovery of unrelated quantization variants.
verdict_reason: Single well-scoped bug fix with domain-appropriate review, passing CI, and tests covering the missing-shard and corrupt-shard scenarios.
